limits: Scene workloads differ; exact causal distribution across threads is not measured. The severe user-visible regression and polling/CPU increases are sufficient to reject the experiment.
findings: Removing the original backoff increased polling and calling-thread CPU load dramatically, with much worse throughput. The host branch tests did not establish a useful console scheduling policy.
recommendation: Do not apply this experiment. Original runtime backoff restored in source, experiment removed from active dependency list.
